top_signals.title: Russian Refinery Runs Plunge to Lowest in Decades, Rystad Says
top_signals.summary: Russia’s oil processing rates have plunged to the lowest in more than two decades as Ukraine continues to strike refineries, according to Rystad Energy, heaping pressure on the country’s domestic fuel supplies.

top_signals.title: CoreWeave, Nvidia Credit Risk Hit Fresh Highs as AI Fears Mount
top_signals.summary: CoreWeave Inc. and Nvidia Corp. credit-risk measures hit fresh all-time highs Wednesday while gauges of perceived fears again reached levels last seen in March, as Wall Street grew increasingly fearful about the tech sector’s record borrowing to finance artificial intelligence.
